ideas.title: +1 Spoon Dig 🥄
ideas.hook: All you have is a spoon. Every scoop gives +1 dig power, and your tunnel goes from cell floor through dirt, rock and sewer pipes until you pop up outside the fence.
core_loop: Scoop under your bunk with the spoon (+1 dig power per scoop)
Break through tougher layers: dirt, clay, rock, old pipes
Spend dig power on better tools (fork, trowel, drill)
Surface outside the fence to finish a prison
Rebirth into a higher-security prison with deeper layers
ideas.twist: Guard sweeps every 60 seconds: hop back into your bed and cover the hole with a poster, or lose the last layer you dug.
monetization: Golden spoon (VIP) with faster sweeps warning
ideas.why_now: Prison / police jumped 0.55 this week to 1.53 momentum (high confidence; Tesla Roadster Chase 9,437 CCU at 15 days, Punch Out Of Prison 4,017 at 20 days). +1 stat per action is at 2.04 with 36 new games (+1 Venom Evolution 23,034, +1 Spider Arm 14,811), and +1 paired with Escape / run already has 10 young games. +1 slipped 0.29 week on week, so the prison angle is what makes it fresh.
ideas.differentiator: Punch-out escapes are about smashing walls; this is a slow, sneaky tunnel with a guard-sweep timer and layer-by-layer progression.

ideas.title: Draw Paths for Robots 🤖
ideas.hook: Little delivery robots only follow lines. Draw their path across a busy factory floor so they dodge crushers and lasers and reach the exit door.
core_loop: Look at the level: robots, hazards, exit
Draw one path per robot with your finger or mouse
Press go and watch them roll
Earn bolts for robots saved and ink left over
Unlock new robot types (jumpers, magnets, splitters)
ideas.twist: Co-op mode: each player draws for a different robot, and paths that cross cause pile-ups.
retention: Daily puzzle with a leaderboard for least ink used
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is the strongest climbing mechanic: 2.18 momentum, up 0.31 this week with 18 new games (Ragdoll Sandbox 12,539 at 20 days, 🎬 Make a Cartoon! 8,099). Robots / mechs sits at 2.08 (high confidence; [🔰] Steel Fighters 8,747, [🎃] Clean the Moon! 6,052), and Paint + Robots is the top gap in the data. Linear-course maps are rising too (2.01).
ideas.differentiator: Drawing here is the controls, not decoration: your line is the robot's route, so every level is a quick physics-light puzzle.

ideas.title: Rent a Robot 🔧
ideas.hook: Run a robot rental lot. Customers rent your bots for jobs like lawn mowing or moving houses, and bring them back dented, muddy or with a new personality.
core_loop: Build robots on your lot from parts
Match each customer to the right robot
Collect rent when the robot comes back
Repair and wash returns before the next rental
Expand the lot with bigger and rarer robots
ideas.twist: Some robots come back 'learned' a habit (dancing, stealing socks). Weird habits make them worth more to certain customers, so players hunt for them.
retention: Index of robot habits to collect
Daily VIP customer with a big order
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop holds 1.71 momentum with 28 new games spread out (Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 21,967, 🧸 My Small Business 9,980, Sell a Million Sushi 9,694). Robots / mechs is at 2.08 (high confidence) and Tycoon / base building at 1.36 with 78 new games.
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell goods once; here you lend the same robots again and again, and they come back changed.

ideas.title: Bank After Hours 💰
ideas.hook: You fell asleep in the bank and the doors locked. Get out through the vault floors before morning, grabbing as much cash as you dare. The bag gets heavier and you get slower.
core_loop: Wake up in a locked bank floor
Crack simple locks to move down a level
Stuff cash into your bag (heavier = slower)
Dodge night guards and laser grids
Reach the exit and bank your haul for upgrades
ideas.twist: Greed meter: the more you carry, the louder you walk. Drop stacks to sneak past guards, and other players can pick up what you dropped.
retention: Daily vault with a rare bill to collect
ideas.why_now: Escape / run is up 0.47 this week to 1.62 (high confidence; [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 27,743, +1 Spider Arm🕷️ 14,811). Money / rich is at 2.0 with 52 new games (Steal A Balut 13,452 at 18 days). Interior maps are the fastest rising map style at 2.09 (DONT SPLASH 50,746). Realistic art is also climbing (1.63, high).
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Not a steal-from-players base game: it is a short stealth escape where your loot slows you down.

ideas.title: Restore Old Coins 🪙
ideas.hook: Scrub, polish and buff crusty old coins in first person until the design shows through. Some turn out to be rare and sell for a fortune.
core_loop: Pick a dirty coin from the bucket
Scrub off grime with brushes and polish
Reveal the coin's design and rarity
Sell it at your counter or keep it for the album
Buy better tools and bigger buckets
ideas.twist: Over-polishing wipes off detail and halves the value, so players learn when to stop.
retention: Coin album with sets to complete
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 0.31 this week to 2.18 (high confidence), and the newest paint games are first-person cleaning and restoring (Clean a Painting 2,246 CCU, [🥞] Paint a Pancake). Money / rich sits at 2.0 with 52 new games, and Sell / run a shop at 1.71 (Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 21,967).
ideas.differentiator: The satisfying scrub-and-reveal of cleaning games, but every reveal is a lottery ticket with a real collection behind it.

ideas.title: Run an Ice Hotel 🏨
ideas.hook: Build a hotel out of ice blocks and check in guests. Fire-type guests pay the most, but they melt the walls if you don't cool their rooms fast enough.
core_loop: Carve ice blocks and build rooms
Check in guests (snow, wind and fire types)
Keep each room's temperature in the safe zone
Collect payment and tips at checkout
Unlock new floors, a lobby and an ice slide
ideas.twist: Fire guests pay triple but heat up neighbours' rooms, so room layout becomes a puzzle.
ideas.why_now: Ice / fire / elements is up 0.20 to 1.53 momentum (high confidence; [🎃] Ice Cream Shop [Anomaly] 🍦 6,264, Firefighting Sim 🚒 4,901). Tycoon / base building has 78 new games at 1.36, and Sell / run a shop holds 1.71 (🧸 My Small Business 9,980).
ideas.differentiator: A hotel tycoon where the building itself is at risk from your best customers, so layout and cooling matter as much as income.

ideas.title: Grow a Geode 💎
ideas.hook: Plant geode seeds in your cave plot, water them with mineral water, and crack them open when they're ripe. Bigger and older geodes hide rarer crystals.
core_loop: Plant geode seeds in your cave plot
Feed them mineral water while they grow
Crack ripe geodes with a hammer
Sell or display the crystals inside
Buy rarer seeds and expand the cave
ideas.twist: Leave a geode growing longer for a chance at a huge crystal, but it can crack on its own and spill to neighbours.
retention: Daily rare seed in the shop
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is up 0.49 this week to 1.62 (high confidence; [2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution 8,841, [UPD] Durian Garden 🍈 8,084 at 15 days). Stones / rocks / ores is up 0.30 to 1.70 (medium confidence; Cut a Rock 16,988).
ideas.differentiator: A farm where the harvest is a surprise: you never know what is inside until you crack it.

ideas.title: Cook for the Horde 🧟
ideas.hook: Your diner is the last one in town, and the zombies are hungry. Keep them fed and happy at the counter, or they stop ordering and start breaking in.
core_loop: Take orders from zombies at the window
Cook their weird dishes (brain burgers, toe fries)
Serve before the hunger meter fills
Earn coins and spend them on faster stoves and stronger shutters
Survive longer nights with bigger hordes
ideas.twist: Each zombie wants a dish matching what it was before it turned: the chef zombie is picky, the kid zombie wants dessert.
ideas.why_now: Zombies is up 0.18 to 1.63 momentum (high confidence; Ragdoll Reality 🩸 16,987, [UPDATE 1.0] 30 Floors Up 5,320 at 11 days). Cook / serve is up 0.17 to 1.20 (medium confidence; Cook the Chicken (by slapping it) 8,360, Save the Krusty Krab 🍔 5,168). Sell / run a shop holds 1.71.
ideas.differentiator: Cooking is the defence: there are no guns, only food, and a slow kitchen turns into a siege.

ideas.title: Raid the Giant's Fridge 🧀
ideas.hook: You're tiny and live inside the walls of a giant's house. Sneak into the kitchen at night, haul crumbs and cheese back home, and run when the giant wakes.
core_loop: Leave your wall base through a mouse hole
Climb counters and shelves to reach food
Carry it back before the giant or the cat spots you
Use food to build and upgrade your wall base
Unlock new rooms: pantry, bathroom, garden
ideas.twist: The giant's routine changes each night, and loud players wake him up for everyone on the server.
retention: Base keeps producing while you're away
ideas.why_now: Giant / huge is at 1.66, up 0.12 (high confidence; Bug Evolution [🦟] 18,403, Raise The Biggest Family 9,351). Escape / run is up 0.47 to 1.62 (high confidence), and interior maps lead map styles at 2.09. Realistic art is rising at 1.63.
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: The whole map is one giant house seen from the size of a mouse, with a real home base to grow between raids.

ideas.title: Spacewalk Home 🧑‍🚀
ideas.hook: Your tether snapped. Push off floating station wreckage to drift back to the airlock before your oxygen runs out.
core_loop: Aim and push off debris to drift
Grab oxygen canisters along the route
Avoid spinning panels and sparks
Reach the airlock checkpoint
Spend stars on better suits and thrusters
ideas.twist: No gravity: every push keeps you moving until you grab something, so overshooting a checkpoint is the main danger.
ideas.why_now: Space is up 0.13 to 1.61 momentum (medium confidence; [🎃] Clean the Moon! 6,052, Sweep The Moon 🌕 1,478 at 13 days). Escape / run is up 0.47 to 1.62 (high confidence), and linear-course maps are rising at 2.01. Escape + Obby already has 8 young games.
ideas.differentiator: An obby with no ground: movement is push-and-drift, so it plays unlike any jump obby.
